knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The lesson says the customer buys a checked clean of the named appliance and the certainty that a missed item will be put right. Your rate, kit and business age are inputs to the offer, not what the customer buys.
The lesson says the minimum can override the item price on a small job, so the quote should show the item price and the minimum beside it, and say that the minimum applies to this small job.

The lesson says Victoria's gas guidance requires only persons with the right gasfitting endorsement, such as Type B for Type B appliances, to work on those appliances. The cleaner should refer the client on and keep the adjustment out of scope.
